description: Create an item (row) with all of its data in one call. cells maps columnId -> value (use get_board_schema for column ids); every cell is saved with the row. Use set_cell only for later edits.

cells.description: Cell values keyed by column id: { "<columnId>": value }. Scalars, { amount, currency } for currency, { relatedItemIds: [...] } for relations

priority.description: Priority: low, medium, high or urgent

status.description: Task status of the row on a task board: todo, in_progress, review or done. Refused on a data board, where it would only write a hidden task field: set that board's status column with cells (create_item) or set_cell (update_item) instead

tags.description: Tags as an array of strings

title.description: Item title, shown as the row name

name: create_item
